jobs.title: Graduate Product Management Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Graduate Product Marketing Engineer

This role represents an excellent opportunity for someone looking to establish a career in a fast-growing, award-winning, global semiconductor company with a clearly defined career development path.

This role is part of our 2027 Graduate programme and will start in September 2027.

Following the Company's extensive onboarding and introduction program, you will join our Graduate Development programme that includes: Technical Classroom training, Soft-skills training, Team building, Corporate responsibility activities and finally placement across all our marketing, operations and process teams.

It is not required for you to already have the skills and knowledge to perform the role, full on the job training will be provided through our graduate develop scheme. You will then be welcomed into your Team and continue your development supported by your SPTS mentor!

Product Marketing Introduction:
The Product Marketing team within SPTS are involved in various aspects of the marketing function including supporting systems sales efforts and setting product roadmaps.  Starting with qualifying the sales opportunity, answering questions from the sales team/customer, responding to customer specifications and visit customer sites to progress sales prospects.

In the factory, alongside engineering, product marketing arrange and manage customer demos, and when circumstances allow, host live demos with customers on site.  Through interaction with various resources including the customer base, suppliers and analysts the product marketing team develop an understanding of our markets and position within those markets aiming to contribute to the overall product development and planning processes.

For product development activities, the team create and prioritise roadmap targets.  This involves setting the scene for the division to follow using the KLA Product Life Cycle (PLC) process.

Product Marketing’s responsibilities don’t stop after the sales process has been completed. The team assist the account teams providing updates on product development, market trends and acting as the customer representative in any factory-based work.

There may also be opportunities to work with Corporate Marketing on the creation of promotional materials and attendance (virtual or in person) at trade shows/technical conferences.

This position may also involve occasional international travel.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Product roadmap definition
- Long-term forecasting
- Generation and presentation of marketing collateral
- Coordination and/or response to customer specification documents
- Ownership of boiler plate specification documentation for field reference.
- Generating Throughput and Cost-of-Ownership (CoO) data using industry-standard models
- Generating and updating System Configuration Documents (SCD) to define manufacturing builds
- Sample demonstration coordination with engineering and account teams
- Hosting customer visits for live demonstrations or show & tell
- Developing and maintaining contacts with customers and suppliers
- Writing and submitting abstracts and papers to relevant conferences and trade shows

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Whilst no experience is necessary, in your application and through assessment you’ll show us you have:
- Has a passion for learning and development, continuously seeking for new knowledge and learning opportunities.
- Can think logically to provide customer solutions with a good attention to detail and foresight and ability to collect, filter and analyse data to build solutions for complex technological problems
- Has the ability to think creatively of novel but practical solutions to customer problems
- Is able to demonstrate strong communication skills – You’ll enjoy establishing and maintaining good working relationships with both customers and colleagues.

Your qualifications:
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (2:1) in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or Material Science.
- Applicants with a Master’s Degree or prior experience of studies within the semiconductor industry would be desirable but certainly not a must.
- A good acquaintance with SW tools (MS Office especially PowerPoint, Excel and Co-Pilot) would be advantageous.

What we will offer you?

SPTS benefits package includes: Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme, life assurance.

Minimum Qualifications
BSc / BEng / BA

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Primary Purpose of Role
Working in the Product Marketing Operations (PM Ops) team within SPTS, the Product Marketing Coordinator (PMC) is responsible for supporting multiple operational aspects of the Product Marketing function, enabling Product Marketing Managers to focus on strategic tasks and customer engagement.

The primary focus of the PMC is to create and manage the marketing-defined machine build specification requirements that Manufacturing Operations will work to, known within the organisation as the System Configuration Document (SCD).

Key Responsibilities & Areas of Involvement
Working alongside other Product Marketing Coordinators, the role will involve extensive interaction with Sales, Manufacturing Operations, Engineering and Marketing peers.

System Configuration Document (SCD) Coordination
- Slot plan demand tracking
- SCD coordination, generation and revision control
- Final Quote Review coordination and hosting
- Interaction with SAP sub-contractors

Sample Demonstration Coordination
- Demo Request Form (DRF) review coordination & responses to sales
- Sample Demo Schedule Host & updates to sales
- Demo Statistics support for management review
- Live Demo/Factory Visit logistics

RFQ Response Coordination
When sized appropriately, a longer-term objective for the PM Ops team will be to coordinate (and contribute to) review and response of machine specifications along with quote guidance to Sales Operations, releasing Product Marketing Managers to focus on more strategic and customer-facing activities.

Knowledge of some of the following would be advantageous:
Some knowledge of Semiconductor Processing equipment would be beneficial but is not mandatory.
The candidate is expected to be familiar with SAP, Powerpoint and Excel spreadsheets.
Personal skills
- Enthusiastic with a positive attitude
- Self-motivated and proactive
- Open, co-operative, empathetic
- Excellent attention to detail
- Able to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
- Able to work across all levels within the company, and across regions
- Excellent communication skills
